title: Planet Tweaks V3.1.0 NOVA TITAN - Dedicated App Debloat, Keyboard & Mouse Pro Packs, Diego & Niki Viral Themes
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.1.0 NOVA TITAN: (1) Dedicated App Debloat Suite: Complete separation of App & Browser Debloat into its own dedicated sidebar tab featuring 1-click debloaters for Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, Brave Browser, Discord (DSCP 46 QoS + Stream Lag Fix), Spotify, Razer Co-Installer Blocker, and Logitech Download Assistant Blocker. (2) Two New Pro Packs: Dedicated Keyboard Pro Pack (0ms repeat delay, maximum 31 repeat rate, FilterKeys lockout purge) and Mouse Zero-Delay Pack (1:1 MarkC raw linear curves, MouseDataQueueSize=8, AAPThreshold=0). (3) Diego & Niki Viral UI Themes: Added 6 new 60-30-10 color palettes (Acid Lime Cyber, Solar Coral Navy, Forest Electric Violet, Kinetic Tangerine, Royal Health Purple, Deep Solix Blue) to desktop app and website with 10% electric action button styling. (4) Custom Typography & Text Color Studio: Full text color customization in Studio drawer. (5) Complete Unicode Polish: Purged all legacy corrupt characters across website and client.
